msg: DESIGN TARGET (blocks.md B4): settled to 0.1 % of the 2.785 V step within 150 us of the edge. Gated as the peak-to-peak residual in the window that opens 150 us after the edge, so it needs no hard-coded threshold. Measured 2e-14 V.

DESIGN TARGET (blocks.md B4). Full-scale step overshoot at J2 into CL = 1 nF (REQUIREMENTS Q8 worst case) with NO isolation resistor fitted, measured 0.61 % - low because U1's 45.8 kHz pole and the OPA2333's 0.16 V/us slew rate turn the edge into a ~17 us ramp. The small-signal stability margin is b11, not this.
REQUIREMENTS Q5 ('clips gracefully and recovers'). The output must not invert or collapse anywhere in the 1 ms +25 mV overload. Measured 3.038 V, i.e. it never leaves the top.
DESIGN TARGET (blocks.md B1/B4). Clipped level during overload, measured 3.2829 V.
DESIGN TARGET (blocks.md B4): recovered to 0.1 % within 300 us of leaving overload. Measured 0 V.
DESIGN TARGET (blocks.md B4, design ~30 us). Settling time to +-0.1 % of the step, measured 23.2 us.

DESIGN TARGET (blocks.md B4), measured 20.7 us. WARNING not error: this number is set by the macromodel's 0.4 V anti-windup headroom divided by the datasheet slew rate. NEITHER datasheet states an overload recovery time, so the model cannot predict one. What b4 proves about overload is structural - no inversion, no fold-back.
